title: The model catalog got canonical names without breaking old code
summary:
A compatibility-heavy day: cleaner model names, steadier generation recovery, memorable upload URLs, and the docs catching up with reality.

Public model IDs now use a consistent canonical catalog naming scheme with publisher metadata, while legacy aliases, routing, stored keys, and existing permissions keep working. Scoped-key reads and the Enter migration were updated alongside it, so old and renamed model identifiers resolve consistently through the rollout.

Coordinator failures now check for an already-cached generation before trying again, returning completed work without a duplicate provider call. Production deployments also preserve Klein's intended VPC route, with CI checking that the correct deployment tooling is actually in charge.

POST /upload accepts optional account-scoped custom IDs for multipart and JSON uploads, making stable media URLs possible without coordinating random identifiers. Create-only writes safely reject collisions from existing files or gallery entries.
